crossRefs.note: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.
All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May Yahweh make the woman who has come…
The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the…
The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field.”
But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife…
Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

translations.web: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
translations.bsb: Every wise woman builds her house, but a foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
translations.kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
translations.asv: Every wise woman buildeth her house; But the foolish plucketh it down with her own hands.
